uv.u: 0..1 once around, arclength along actual top contour; slight >1 at seam loops
uv.uDirection: counterclockwise viewed from above in Blender; reads correctly from outside

import.instantiate: identity position/rotation/scale in same scene space as Sala_MLR.fbx; exporter is identical -Z forward, Y up

rendering.shader: URP unlit emissive live RenderTexture, no new VideoPlayer required
rendering.layout: Two identical 2048x256 horizontal panels around circumference; layout phase editable by UV offset

notes: Only exterior tapered fascia is overlaid. Inner well, underside, pink outer ring, hanging supports and projectors are preserved.
The original fascia is tapered: it is intentionally not replaced by a true vertical cylinder.
Mesh has no collider and must not be assigned a wall video ProjectionSurface.
No source media, fonts or logos are included; root provides live event UI.
